tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8.26Let $M_1 \subset \mathbb {R}^3$ be the plane $\{ z = 0\} $, and let $M_2 \subset \mathbb {R}^3$ be the cylinder $\{ x^2 + y^2 = 1\} $. Show that $M_1$ and $M_2$ are locally isometric, but the former has mean curvature zero, while the latter has mean curvature $\pm 1/2$, depending on which normal is chosen. \end{exercise}
